<?php
class TypedGetLiteral {
    private int $yes = 100;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool {
        echo "I:", $incoming, ";";
        return $incoming === "yes";
    }
    public function __get(string $incoming) {
        echo "G:", $incoming, ";";
        return 7;
    }
}
class TypedGetLiteralOnly {
    private int $yes = 100;
    public function __get(string $incoming) { echo "BADGET;"; return 7; }
}
$o = new TypedGetLiteral;
echo isset($o->no) ? "BAD;" : "IF;";
echo isset($o->yes) ? "IT;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($o->no) ? "EF;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($o->yes) ? "BAD;" : "ET;";
echo ($o->no ?? 9) === 9 ? "CF;" : "BAD;";
echo ($o->yes ?? 9) === 7 ? "CT;" : "BAD;";
$only = new TypedGetLiteralOnly;
echo empty($only->yes) ? "SKIP;" : "BAD;";
